channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Ukraine launches over 1,000 drones at Russia, setting oil facilities ablaze
item.description: The air strike, one of Ukraine's largest in the war, comes amid rising tensions between Kyiv and Washington.

item.title: Iran war live: US issues Middle East security alert; Yemen fighting flares
item.description: US embassies in the Middle East have issued a security alert for Americans as fighting in Yemen continues to ramp up.

item.title: Fire engulfs Albania’s Supreme Court as protests enter fifth day
item.description: Offices at the Supreme Court in Tirana were set ablaze as anti-government protests continue.

item.title: Kenya pastor accused of ordering parents to starve their children to death faces verdict
item.description: Prosecutors say Paul Mackenzie lured the latest victims to their deaths by writing notes from his prison cell.

item.title: Bomb threat forces Israel to Austria flight into emergency landing
item.description: The Airbus jet landed safely in Bulgaria and all passengers and crew aboard were unharmed, officials said.

item.title: Oil facilities hit in deadly overnight attack on St Petersburg
item.description: At least one person was killed in the strikes, which also hit a data centre used by Russia's equivalent of Facebook.

item.title: European diplomats attacked by Israeli settlers in West Bank
item.description: The Israeli military condemns the violence but the prime minister's office says it is part of a "smear" campaign.

item.title: Anti-government protesters battle with police in Albania
item.description: There were violent clashes between demonstrators and riot police throughout Saturday in the capital Tirana.
